notes.title: CLOVERPIT IS OUT NOW!!!!
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone,

[/p][p][b]Here’s what to expect from the game:[/b]

[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]And if you'd like to listen to [b]our soundtrack on repeat[/b] (who wouldn't), just head [url="https://clementpanchout.bandcamp.com/album/cloverpit-ost"]here[/url]![/p][p][/p][p]We would appreciate feedback in the steam forums and comments as we are working on patches so that we can keep making this game as great as possible!
[/p][p]Anyway enough talk, more gambling 👀
[/p][p]WE WILL SEE YOU IN THE PIT [/p][p]-Matteo & Lorenzo from Panik Arcade[/p][p]
[/p]

SEE YOU IN THE PIT ON FRIDAY!

notes.title: New demo update!!
notes.notes:

[/p][p]We hope you’re as excited for launch day as we are! Just over three weeks until the 26th! Ahhhhhh!
[/p][p]Now, as you know today was our original launch date, which had to move due to a certain game *cough silksong cough* launching the day after, and we’re super grateful for the response we’ve had from you all. We’d like to thank you for your patience and understanding, so we’ve decided to treat you all to a big demo update as we couldn’t leave you with nothing today, could we! ♥️ This experience is now much closer to the 1.0 build, so you can get more of a taste in the run-up to launch. [/p][p][/p][p]Here are all the updates to go check out! [/p][p][/p][p]💎[b]Steam achievements![/b][/p][p]🍋 [b]4 new extra charm modifiers[/b] with powerful effects!

[/p][p]Talk soon and see you in the pit[/p][p]-Matteo & Lorenzo from Panik Arcade[/p][p]

notes.title: 'Silksong lol': CloverPit devs delay the slot machine Balatro-like by 23 days to escape the blast radius of Silksong's launch
notes.notes: You know what they say: The best laid plans of mice and men sometimes get abruptly derailed by a surprise launch announcement. Thanks to yesterday's reveal that Silksong's release date is only two weeks away, CloverPit developer Panik Arcade has decided to push back the launch of the slot machine roguelite to dodge the all-consuming attention singularity that we can safely expect the Hollow Knight sequel to be... Read more.

notes.title: 🍋🍒WE HAVE TO DELAY CLOVERPIT A BIT (SILKSONG lol)!🔔🍀
notes.notes:
[p]Hi everyone![/p][p][/p][p]We have some news to share: we have decided to delay the launch of CloverPit a little.
[/p][p]The good news is it’s not long: [b]CloverPit will now launch on the 26th September!![/b][/p][p][/p][p]Some of you might already have guessed the reason for the delay: Hollow Knight: Silksong.
[/p][p]The release date for Silksong was announced yesterday, and it’s only one day after CloverPit our original launch date. Silksong is the most anticipated and wishlisted game on all of Steam and we think people will love this game and play it right at launch (including us) but that also means it will overshadow all games launching close to it. So if we stick to our original date we would risk the launch of CloverPit a fair bit.[/p][p][/p][p]We poured our hearts into our little game so of course we want to give it the best possible shot. We hope you can understand - we’ll use the extra time of course to polish the game even further and we hope for your support at launch either way.[/p][p]
See you in the pit!

[/p][p]-Matteo & Lorenzo from Panik Arcade[/p][p]
[/p][p]

[/p]

notes.title: Demo update! 🎰
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Again, we’d just like to say thank you so so much for playing our demo, we are currently #11 on the trending charts for ALL Steam releases and we’re reaching all new player peaks every 15 mins 🤯 The response has just been so wild, we could never have imagined this so thank you very much!!!

Based on the wonderful feedback from you guys, we have just pushed an update to the demo to improve your experience. Here are the main updates: 

[h3]Charms 🍀[/h3]
[list]
[*]The red button now emits a small sound when you have charms, so you’re reminded to use it! 
[*]Enchanted (Modded) charms when discarded now reward a higher amount of coins
[*]‘Raging Capitalist’ is now capped at 25% as per the text!
[/list]

[h3]Localization 🌍[/h3]
[list]
[*]For the French speakers, we have adjusted the translation of some of the charms to make more sense!
[*]Fixed a bug with initial language selection

[/list]

[h3]Game 💻[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added steam cloud for the demo data
[*]Data is now encrypted and screenshots are more trustable!

You can also sign up to playtest the full game by joining our previous game’s [url=https://discord.com/invite/NhnK2KU3BS]Discord[/url], as we’ve just added some channels dedicated to CloverPit!

Again, we hope you continue to enjoy our demo, and follow us on [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@panikarcadegames]Tiktok[/url] & [url=https://x.com/PanikArcade]Twitter[/url] for more on this crazy journey!! 

- Matteo and Lorenzo from Panik Arcade

notes.title: Over 22,000 Wishlists and 12k demo players on day 1 - THANK YOU!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

What a day, what a night, what a 24 hours!

When we announced our game yesterday during the Triple-I showcase, little did we know that we’d get to be [b]Top 1 in the Steam charts for “Trending Free” games[/b], have [b]over 11,000 players try our demo[/b], and get [b]over 22,000 wishlists in just a day[/b]!

This is so wild for us - we’re just a little team of two, making the games we like to play, hoping others will share our love for weird jokes and crazy gameplay.
Honestly, kinda speechless right now! What a day, what a day…

To everyone who’s tried our demo - thank you so much! We love to read your reactions, we love to hear your feedback, and we’re grateful for all your ideas and hot takes!

We’re also aware there are some bugs and some things left to be improved in the demo, and are actively working on patches to fix those - expect some sneaky update in the next day for a more polished experience 🙂

Finally, if you’re [b]interested in being part of a playtest[/b] of the full version of the game in the months to come, make sure you stop by our previous game, [i]Yellow Taxi Goes Vroom[/i], [b][url=https://discord.gg/ne8DZ6dm]Discord[/url][/b] - we’ve just added some channels dedicated to [b]CloverPit[/b]!

Thank you so much, and ci vediamo presto!
- Matteo and Lorenzo from Panik Arcade

notes.title: Gamble or die in a 'never-ending debt simulator' that plays like Balatro spliced with a demonic slot machine
notes.notes: You think Balatro had trouble convincing rating boards and YouTube it's not gambling? I predict CloverPit, a self-described "rogue-lite slot machine nightmare," is going to have to work twice as hard... Read more.

notes.title: Welcome to your new addiction 😈
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Welcome to our little slice of Hell, Cloverpit 🍒

We are Panik Arcade, devs of Yellow Taxi Goes Vroom, and we are so thrilled to be announcing our latest project in the Triple-i showcase! What an honour to be part of such a cool event amongst so many incredible titles! 🤩

[previewyoutube=8Ir6ZnqerQ0;full][YT trailer][/previewyoutube]

To celebrate this announcement we have launched our first DEMO! You can play the game and get those numbers spinning right now!!

Before you dive in, here’s what to expect from the full game:

🍀Manipulate the slot machine to earn gazillion coins?!
🍀Trigger big big combos, and break the game with 150 + unlockable items and synergies
🍀A hellish escape room atmosphere with multiple endings
🍀You must pay off your debt at the end of each round, or fall to ruin…literally
🍀Endless Mode allows you to push your score to new heights
🍀A sinister tale of addiction and escape…


Finally, you may be wondering ‘Is this Gambling?’… Abso-fruit-ley not! CloverPit is a rogue-lite horror game, and not a slot machine simulator. Our slot machine is designed to be broken and ultimately overcome, and will never ask you for real money. We will though as we would really love for you to buy our game when it launches later this year 👀

That’s enough from us, go play our demo right now and discover it all for yourself. We hope to see you on the other side…

- Panik Arcade gang
